causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Temperatures in western Sydney reached 40°C driving demand to 13 485 MW at 4 pm. During the time of high prices demand was up to 920 MW higher than that forecast four hours ahead.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Over several rebids from 7.59 am, effective from the 10.30 am trading interval, Macquarie Generation reduced the available capacity of Liddell unit one by a total of 205 MW (all of which was priced at negative prices). The reasons given were related to the delay of a feed pump returning to service.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: At 9.48 am Eraring Energy reduced the available capacity of Eraring unit four by 70 MW (all of which was priced below zero). The reason given was "0943P Revised commissioning capacity".

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: The market impact of this constraint was made worse following rebidding by Delta Electricity — initially by reducing its generator ramp rates, then by shifting capacity into higher prices and then reducing maximum availability.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: At 6.32 am Delta Electricity rebid the ramp rates of Mount Piper units one and two. The rebid took effect from 10.05 am and reduced the 'ramp down rate' on each unit from 5 MW/min, to the minimum allowable level of 3 MW/min.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: During the period of high prices, flows into New South Wales from Queensland (across the QNI and Terranora interconnectors) and Victoria (across the VIC-NSW interconnector) were at their limits but at much lower levels than the nominal capacity.

constraints_named.quote: The system normal constraint N>>N-NIL__S bound for much of 17 December.

interconnectors_named.name: QNI
interconnectors_named.quote: During the period of high prices, flows into New South Wales from Queensland (across the QNI and Terranora interconnectors) and Victoria (across the VIC-NSW interconnector) were at their limits but at much lower levels than the nominal capacity.
